    code: "async def open_next_at_section_start(section_name):
    next_button = page.locator("a.nav-forward")
    if not await next_button.count() or not await next_button.first.is_visible():
        raise RuntimeError(f"The Next button was not visible at the start of {section_name}")
    await next_button.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

await open_next_at_section_start("Section Two")

section_item_links = page.locator("#panel-alpha > aside > div:nth-of-type(5) a[href*='/items/']")
link_count = await section_item_links.count()
if link_count == 0:
    raise RuntimeError("No items were visible in the observed Section Two")

item_urls = []
for index in range(link_count):
    href = await section_item_links.nth(index).get_attribute("href")
    if href and "/items/" in href and href not in item_urls:
        item_urls.append(href)

items_completed = 0
items_started = 0
pages_visited = 0
item_titles = []

async def play_item_if_present():
    global items_completed, items_started
    play_button = page.locator("button[aria-label='Play'][title='Play']")
    progress = page.locator("[role='slider'][aria-label='Progress']")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    if not await play_button.count() or not await progress.count():
        return False
    if not await play_button.first.is_visible() or not await progress.first.is_visible():
        return False
    settings_button = page.locator("button[aria-label='Open options']")
    if await settings_button.count() and await settings_button.first.is_visible():
        await settings_button.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
        rate_menu = page.locator("#menu-beta")
        if await rate_menu.count() and await rate_menu.first.is_visible():
            await rate_menu.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
            fast_label = page.locator("label[for^='opt-gamma-']")
            if await fast_label.count() and await fast_label.first.is_visible():
                await fast_label.first.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    await play_button.first.click()
    items_started += 1
    title = (await page.locator("body").inner_text())[:160]
    item_titles.append(title)
    if bool(setup_only):
        return True
    duration_value = await progress.first.get_attribute("aria-valuemax")
    if not duration_value:
        raise RuntimeError("The observed progress control did not expose an item duration")
    duration_seconds = float(duration_value)
    completed = False
    for _ in range(int(duration_seconds / 60) + 10):
        await page.wait_for_timeout(30000)
        position_value = await progress.first.get_attribute("aria-valuenow")
        if position_value and float(position_value) >= duration_seconds - 2:
            completed = True
            break
    if not completed:
        raise RuntimeError("An item did not reach completion during bounded playback checks")
    items_completed += 1
    return True

for item_url in item_urls:
    await page.goto("https://example.com" + item_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    pages_visited += 1
    played = await play_item_if_present()
    if played and bool(setup_only):
        return {"setup_confirmed": True, "intro_skipped": True, "current_item_url": page.url, "items_started": items_started, "items_completed": items_completed, "pages_visited": pages_visited, "visible_evidence": (await page.locator("body").inner_text())[:800]}

extras_section_url = "https://example.com/catalog/sections/extras#view"
await page.goto(extras_section_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
extras_links = page.locator("#panel-alpha > aside > div:nth-of-type(7) a[href*='/items/']")
extras_count = await extras_links.count()
extras_urls = []
for index in range(extras_count):
    href = await extras_links.nth(index).get_attribute("href")
    if href and "/items/" in href and href not in extras_urls:
        extras_urls.append(href)

extras_pages_visited = 0
for item_url in extras_urls:
    await page.goto("https://example.com" + item_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    extras_pages_visited += 1
    played = await play_item_if_present()
    if played and bool(setup_only):
        return {"setup_confirmed": True, "intro_skipped": True, "current_item_url": page.url, "items_started": items_started, "items_completed": items_completed, "pages_visited": pages_visited, "extras_pages_visited": extras_pages_visited, "visible_evidence": (await page.locator("body").inner_text())[:800]}

return {"setup_confirmed": items_started > 0, "intro_skipped": True, "items_started": items_started, "items_completed": items_completed, "pages_visited": pages_visited, "extras_pages_visited": extras_pages_visited, "final_item_url": page.url, "visible_evidence": (await page.locator("body").inner_text())[:800]}
